name: Witty Fly 56
author: csemszepp
description: Gradient rounded white toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: left becomes 40%, box-shadow becomes inset 0 0 5px hsl(22deg 20% 15% / 100%),
    inset 20px 20px 10px hsl(22deg 20% 15% / 100%),
    inset 20px 20px 15px hsl(22deg 20% 45% / 100%).
